text:
This slide explains why I use an EWA-inspired model rather than treating EWA as a decorative add-on.
EWA fits the experiment because participants repeatedly choose between self judgment and AI judgment, then observe both actual and counterfactual feedback. That is exactly a learning environment with evolving source attractions.
The reduced-form comparisons remain the main identification strategy. The EWA layer asks whether the observed path differences are consistent with asymmetric updating of AI attraction, especially after early AI errors.
